name: UDG-2B (Hubble)
blurb: UDG-2B, an ultra-diffuse galaxy in a group of galaxies, seen by Hubble.
label: udg2b-hubble
story: UDG-2B is an ultra-diffuse galaxy, with the stars of a dwarf spread across the size of a giant galaxy. Hubble counted its globular clusters to weigh it and compare such ghostly galaxies in quiet groups with those in crowded clusters.

claims.text: UDG-2B is an ultra-diffuse galaxy in a galaxy group (group B) studied with Hubble program 15277
UDG-2B is a low-surface-brightness dwarf galaxy
Ultra-diffuse galaxies have dwarf-like stellar masses spread across giant-galaxy sizes
Program 15277 uses globular cluster systems to weigh UDGs in poor groups and compare them with cluster UDGs
Somalwar et al. studied the globular cluster systems of UDGs in groups with Hubble
